title: Ijwi Rivuye mu Nkengera
intro: Uhagaze mu gisagara aho intumwa zitatu zaje zifise ibimenyetso bigaragara, ariko abantu bakazitwenga, bakaguma ku ngeso zabo za kera. Hari umuntu avuye kure cane y’igisagara, ariruka aja aho abantu bari, ata mpwemu afise kandi yiyemeje, kugira ngo avuge ukuri naho yoba yanse. Uwo mutima washize vyose mu kaga kubera ubutumwa butari ubwabo ni nde?
clues: Nabaye mu bantu bari bakiriye intumwa zifise ibimenyetso bigaragara, yamara barahindukira mu bwibone.
Naje ndiko ndiruka mvuye kure cane y’igisagara, numva intumwa zimpamagara.
Nabwiye abantu banje nti: «Ewe bantu banje, nimukurikire intumwa. Mukurikire abatabasaba impembo, kuko bayobowe neza.’
Sinari umuhanuzi, ariko narizeye intumwa, nca nsaba abantu banje kubigira.
Abantu banje baratwenga impanuro zanje, bakanshinja ko ndi umunyaruyeri.
Igihe banyica, Allah yambwiye ngo ninjire muri Paradizo, nanje nipfuza ko abantu banje bomenya imbabazi n’icubahiro naronse.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Uwo mugabo wo mu gice ca kure cane c’igisagara (Ya-Sin) .
Umwe mu ntumwa zitatu zarungitswe mu gisagara .
Umudandaza azwi cane wo muri ico gisagara .
identity.answer: Uwo mugabo wo mu gice ca kure cane c’igisagara (Ya-Sin) .

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Abwira abantu biwe ngo bakurikire intumwa .
Kubaka ubwato bwo gukiza abizera umwuzure .
trial.answer: Abwira abantu biwe ngo bakurikire intumwa .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yinjiye muri Paradizo yipfuza ko abantu biwe bomenya imbabazi ziwe .
Yarohamye hamwe n'abantu biwe kubera banse ubutumwa .
Yaciye aba umutware inyuma y’urubanza rwiwe .
Yarakijijwe na Allah, agumana n'abantu biwe .
outcome.answer: Yinjiye muri Paradizo yipfuza ko abantu biwe bomenya imbabazi ziwe .

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
